title: 49GAION Standard - bot identity card
description: Every bot states its role, its own separate account, its allowed actions, and the actions that require a prior request to the accountable human.

aioc.description: Widened in v1.5.0 to accept brand prefixes such as TenAIOC-SL and [ORG]AIOC-SL (Naming Standard R13).

role.description: The role card the bot performs.

separate.description: The bot's own account; never a human's and never shared with another bot.

ask_first_actions.description: Actions that require a prior request to the accountable human.

accountable_human_position.description: The position (never a person's name) of the accountable human. For the AION Builder: the governing seat (GOV) of 49GAION.

status.description: DRAFT until the card's test has run once with recorded evidence; APPROVED only with that evidence.

credential.description: The bot's own credential (v1.5.0): issued to it alone, held by the one Cell it fills, never shared with another Cell, bot or person, and never reused.

holder.description: Code of the Cell the bot fills.

cell_kind.description: The kind of AI Cell the bot fills (v1.5.0).

never_signs.description: v1.5.0: true for every bot. A bot never signs a listed type, whatever Cell it fills, including a Chief of Staff and an attached AI Cell. Stopping a part under the Standard's stop rules is not a signature.

memory_on_filler_change.description: v1.5.0: when the filler of the Cell changes, the bot's memory of the previous filler is sealed (kept, unreadable to the new filler), never purged.

allOf.$comment: RULE-BOT-V3: a v3 bot card names its own credential, its Cell kind, never_signs and the sealing of memory on a change of filler.
RULE-BOT-NEVER-SIGNS: no bot claims a right to sign.
